scope: One coherent authoring-source contract for seven affected paths and two unresolved nape attachments. No guide edit or build admitted by this document.

responsibilities.witness: visual-review front/angle blue1.2–1.3–1.4; portrait1 swept crown
responsibilities.purpose: Broaden the tight crest while preserving root lift and useful lower waves. Do not flatten it to satisfy sampling.
responsibilities.status: visual authoring purpose established; exact revised coordinates not authored

responsibilities.purpose: Consider restrained variation of bend phase within this family while preserving broad S waves and shoulder-region endpoints. No whole-hairstyle repetition claim from four paths.
responsibilities.status: candidate authoring purpose established; no mandatory change to every path

responsibilities.witness: visual-review orange2.2–2.3–2.4 and purple3.0–3.7; W2/W3/W4/W5 failures
responsibilities.purpose: Preserve the broad crown turn, lifted side entry and useful loose S bends. Any future control re-expression must explicitly serve construction feasibility while retaining visible shape; do not claim a photographed likeness defect.
responsibilities.status: known sampling failures remain unresolved; no particular change is justified or authored

responsibilities.witness: visual-review unresolved seed markers and layout-check missing root correspondence
responsibilities.purpose: Establish actual eligible triangle correspondence before choosing attachment sites. Preserve inner-row construction; no automatic seed translation or mask relaxation.
responsibilities.status: source gap; exact original-seed distances/triangles not yet recorded

sourcePreparationSubstep.operations: Reconstruct frozen eligible scalp triangles using exact coordinate, head-weight and outward-normal predicates; for each of the two original seeds report the closest eligible triangle and exact original seed distance. Record triangle index/vertices/positions, barycentrics, normal/outward dot, corner head weights and eligible coordinate branches. Report strict original25mm pass/fail without accepting an out-of-range result.
sourcePreparationSubstep.stop: One report only; no repeated query, nearest-unfiltered fallback, expanded region, authoring edit, candidate admission or immediate build. The root/critic must decide whether this geometry supports a useful local attachment proposal.

laterRevisionConstraints: Do not mutate the frozen guide JSON or prior evidence; one isolated proposed revision must enumerate changed controls/roots and its rationale, including preservation intents.
Crown-sweep-01 and the other30 unaffected guides remain unchanged. The two preserve-intent guides are not automatically approved for edits.

Preserve40 guides/120 ribbons, original tips and end fractions, widths, roll, atlas/material mappings and eleven inner-guide portions. Existing valid roots remain fixed; only the two unresolved nape attachments are under correspondence review.
Preserve all exact scalp/root/ear/inner-coverage predicates, root offsets and morph-aware root-row checks, q/t roles, frame orientation, generated-surface and triangle-crossing checks.
No new allocation experiment or relaxed0.350mm/40-interval gate; previous diagnostics/compilations and three visual sheets remain consumed.
Do not claim build readiness from crown02/nape work alone. Every known failure must remain explicit until a coherent revised source and bounded qualification are separately admitted.
Later source review must specify evidence reuse for unchanged curves, gaps for changed curves and exact qualification workload. No compiler adaptation or execution is admitted now.
No new camera fit, capture, source search, cap/ornament/default groom, whole-character redesign, face/eye/brow change or macOS settings change.
reviewDecisionNeeded: Review the exact read-only correspondence source and workload first. Root may separately admit that single report. Authoring edits, revised guide JSON and candidate compilation remain distinct later decisions, not automatic consequences.

alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves more useful shape; unresolved preserve-intent guides still need a defensible construction solution. Selected for source preparation.
More freedom to make the family coherent, but greater shape change and reference drift risk. Not selected now.

acceptanceLimits: No likeness, finish, expression meaning, coverage, clearance, root motion or hair appearance qualified. Goal remains complete animated Ember with approved eyes and the full character roadmap.
